profile_text: As a leading provider of hotel and accommodation services in Düsseldorf, Germany, this company has experienced significant growth, with a 24.0% increase in employees since its baseline. Its strategic location in Düsseldorf, a major business and tourism hub, has driven demand for its services, contributing to its expansion. With 31 employees in 2024, the company is well-positioned to continue scaling its operations to meet the needs of its growing customer base.
